title: Neighbor Big Eyed Lut and first lessons with Professor Kutcher
summary: Admired a neighbor's style, begged for a cheap instrument at 15 and took lessons at the Italian Hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Well, my next door neighbor, his name was Big Eyed Lut. Mm-hmm. And, uh, I used to admire his style, but I was only about eight or nine years old. Yeah. And I still remember him. And around 15 years old, uh, I asked the old man to buy McLaren and he said, nope. So I had to beg for about two or three weeks. Finally, he got me a little cheap one for about thirty dollars. Mm-hmm. And I started to take lessons. I had, uh, started going to the Italian Hall there. Mm-hmm. And, uh, they had some old professor there. Uh, his name was, uh, was Kutcher, which was his last name. He used to charge me, it was like five hours a month. Professor Kutcher? Yeah.

Yeah, I mean, uh, uh, uh, he started now, he was in the, uh, in the Contessa Antelina thing. Yeah. And then they had another professor there, uh, Professor Leaster, well, uh, uh, that came later, that. Was that the professor, you know, Kutcher College?
